title: MFFT: Multi-Frequency Fusion Transformer for Explainable AI-Generated Image Detection
description: Official open-source implementation, pretrained weights, and inference pipelines for the Multi-Frequency Fusion Transformer (MFFT), a parameter-efficient vision architecture for detecting AI-generated imagery and facial manipulation deepfakes across radial Fourier frequency sub-bands.
